Name: As's dsp Greenhouse for Cornucopia
Author: Awassakura
Description:
[size=6]Introduction: [/size]
[size=4]A greenhouse where all crops of Cornucopia(crops and flowers only, no consider Growable Forage and Crop Bushes)  can be planted and displayed.
﻿This greenhouse can accommodate 112 iridium sprinklers, 15 bushs and 33  trees, and it has teleportation crystals for quick transportation, saving time.
Supported in version 1.6.11.


[/size][size=6]简介：[/size]
[size=3]可以种下聚宝盆系列所有作物（作物和花，没有[/size]Growable Forage and Crop Bushes相关设计[size=3]），用于展示。[/size]
[size=3]可以放112个铱洒，可以种15个灌木和33棵树（合计48棵）。有传送水晶可以节省走路时间。
[/size]支持星露谷1.6.11


[size=6]How to Download:[/size][list]
[*]Download and install SMAPI.
[*]Download and install Content Patcher.
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26261]As 's dsp Greenhouse[/url]﻿(Click to view related information.) ([color=#dd7e6b]Not necessary, but advisable[/color].).
[*]Download and unzip this mod, then place it into the Mods folder.
[/list]
[size=6]如何下载：[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]下载安装SMAPI。[/size]
[*][size=3]下载安装Content Patcher（常说的CPmod）。[/size]
[*]下载并安装[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26261]As 's dsp Greenhouse[/url]。（点击查看详情）﻿（[color=#dd7e6b]非必须但是推荐使用[/color]）
[*][size=3]下载本mod，解压到Mods文件夹里即可。[/size]
[/list]

[size=6]About：[/size]
[size=3]This is the second greenhouse map in my DSP series. When designing this map, it was only considered for the display of Cornucopia crops,[s] so it is designed to require the DSP greenhouse as Requirements .[/s][color=#dd7e6b]It now supports the game's default greenhouse[/color]. Otherwise, if the original crops and the Cornucopia series crops are put together, the map will become very large, which will lead to fatigue in the game experience.(At least, it does for me.)[/size]

[size=3][color=#ffe599]This is an additional map that does not change the original greenhouse. In the DSP Greenhouse, you will find a green teleportation crystal. Through this crystal, you can teleport to the greenhouse within this mod.[/color][s]It currently only supports the extension based on my DSP greenhouse. [/s][color=#dd7e6b]It now supports the game's default greenhouse. [/color][s]If anyone needs to use it as an extension of the original greenhouse, please post it in the posts.[/s][/size][s]
[/s]
[size=6]关于：[/size]
[size=3]这是我的DSP系列温室的第二张温室地图，这张地图在设计时仅考虑了聚宝盆作物的展示，所以将其设计为需要DSP温室作为前置，([color=#dd7e6b]现在支持使用原版温室了！[/color])否则如果将原版作物和聚宝盆系列的作物放到一起地图会变得很大，进而在游戏体验中产生疲劳（至少我会这样）。[/size]
[size=3][color=#ffe599]这是一张额外的地图，不改变原有的温室，你会在DSP Greenhouse中找到一个绿色的传送水晶，通过这个传送水晶，你可以传送到这个mod温室中。[/color][s]目前仅支持基于我的DSP温室扩展[/s]，[color=#dd7e6b]现在支持使用原版的温室了！[/color][s]如果有人需要将其作为原版温室的扩展，请在posts里面提出。[/s][/size]
